ACCIDDA-Chromantis.team_name: Atlantic Coast Center for Infectious Disease Dynamics and Analytics
ACCIDDA-Chromantis.methods: Negative binomial nowcast of recent weeks, then an ensemble of neural networks trained on past Ebola outbreaks.
ACCIDDA-Chromantis.data_inputs: Hub target data (weekly confirmed cases by onset week, all releases); weekly cases by district or health zone from the 2014-15 West Africa (ebov/space-time) and 2018-20 Kivu (andersen-lab, WHO situation reports) Ebola outbreaks.

ACCIDDA-insightcast.team_name: Atlantic Coast Center for Infectious Disease Dynamics and Analytics
ACCIDDA-insightcast.methods: Delay- and revision-based nowcast of recent onset weeks, then a per-location pool of the 5 insight.cast models with the lowest rolling-origin WIS, with extreme and tail trajectories trimmed.
ACCIDDA-insightcast.data_inputs: Hub target data (weekly confirmed cases by week of symptom onset, release available at the submission deadline) and the hub's case-level onset-to-report delays by province.

CEPH-Rtrend_BDBV.methods: A renewal equation method based on Bayesian estimation of Rt from hospitalization data.
CEPH-Rtrend_BDBV.data_inputs: Daily incident Bundibugyo hospitalizations and reported delay

MOBS-GLEAM_BDBV.methods: Stochastic GLEAM metapopulation SEIHFR model with overdispersed transmission and isolation scenarios, calibrated by two-stage ABC to exported cases and DRC situation-report totals.
MOBS-GLEAM_BDBV.data_inputs: Cumulative confirmed cases in the DRC INSP situation reports (31 July to 24 October 2026); symptomatic cases exported to Uganda (WHO situation reports and Disease Outbreak News); early case counts in Beni (North Kivu); daily commuting and IATA/OAG air-travel flows. The hub target data are used only as a check, not for calibration.

NTUCPH-LLM.team_name: National Taiwan University College of Public Health
NTUCPH-LLM.methods: LLM 'experts' reason like human forecasters over a briefing of the epidemic curve and recent situation reports, each giving quantiles of weekly cases; answers pooled across experts and models
NTUCPH-LLM.data_inputs: Hub target data (weekly confirmed cases by onset week, current and earlier releases); hub auxiliary data (daily confirmed cases by onset date, weekly reporting delays by province); DRC's INSP situation reports (https://insp.cd/ebola-17eme-epidemie/) published for the 2026 BDBV outbreak

OHTJHU-BM.team_name: One Health Trust - Johns Hopkins University
OHTJHU-BM.model_name: Timeseries Foundation Model Ensemble with Delay Nowcast (bare minimum)
OHTJHU-BM.methods: Delay-adjusted nowcast of recent onset weeks, then a median ensemble of zero-shot time-series foundation models (Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Moirai 2.0, Timestral) run on nowcast draws.
OHTJHU-BM.data_inputs: Hub target data (weekly confirmed cases by onset week, all releases) and the hub's case-level onset-to-report delays by province.

UQPSU-national_level.team_name: University of Queensland and Penn State University
UQPSU-national_level.methods: Deterministic SEIHRD type model fit using a Sequential Monte Carlo approach
UQPSU-national_level.data_inputs: Number of new cases (alive and dead), deaths (in the CTE and in the community), hospitalized, recovered (from hospitals), from INSP situation reports.

pedro-zonemix.methods: Health-zone nowcast calibrated on past hub releases; per-zone ensemble of renewal, spatial and persistence models; provinces are zone sums.
pedro-zonemix.data_inputs: Hub target data (all releases), the hub's case-level onset-to-report delays, and INRB's public road travel times and WorldPop populations by health zone.

seabbs-renewal.model_name: Province renewal model with BVD Rt (PyRenew)
seabbs-renewal.methods: Province renewal model in PyRenew with pooled Rt, gravity importation and depletion, with a tempered likelihood on BVDOutbreakSize Rt, fitted to known and imputed onsets.
seabbs-renewal.data_inputs: Hub target data (weekly confirmed cases by onset week, observed plus imputed, for the country, provinces and health zones), the hub's published onset-to-report delays by vintage, province populations and population-weighted province centres. The generation interval is BVDOutbreakSize's. The newest BVDOutbreakSize release published by the forecast's cut-off, for its Rt estimates.
